metadata.name: Virginia UAS test facilities with published specifications
metadata.description: Selected Virginia flight facilities with official public dimensions, infrastructure, or operating constraints.
metadata.disclaimer: Inclusion does not imply availability, access, scheduling approval, airworthiness approval, or authorization for a particular aircraft or operation.

properties.name: MARS UAS Airfield
properties.location_precision: Corroborated island runway reference; not a surveyed threshold
properties.published_size: Direct access to 75 square nautical miles of restricted airspace
properties.launch_recovery: 3,000 ft by 75 ft runway; 130 ft by 120 ft VTOL pad in NASA's 2024 handbook
properties.support_infrastructure: Hangar, integration and airfield-management support; confirm usable hangar clearances because published operator and FAA dimensions differ
properties.aircraft_scope: NASA's 2024 handbook describes UAS through Group 3; operator acceptance and mission approval remain aircraft-specific
properties.flight_constraints: Secure federal facility; operations use the NASA Wallops range environment and require coordination through MARS.
properties.access: Coordinated customer access; not a public-use airfield
properties.location_notes: Public mapped runway corroborated against NASA's island map and OurAirports US-7081. Not the separate mainland airport, an access gate, or a flight boundary.

properties.name: NASA Langley UAS Test Range and CERTAIN
properties.site_type: Open-air research range and urban test environment
properties.published_size: Approximately 800 acres of urban and rural airspace in NASA's May 2024 CERTAIN procedures; the original 2015 opening's 100-acre figure is historical
properties.launch_recovery: Caged/indoor facilities and a fixed-wing operating surface; confirm current configuration
properties.support_infrastructure: Remote-operations centers, telemetry, local weather and airspace monitoring described in NASA's 2024 overview
properties.aircraft_scope: NASA's May 2024 overview lists vehicles up to 125 lb; confirm current project eligibility
properties.flight_constraints: NASA's May 2024 procedures describe surface to 400 ft AGL, subject to the applicable COA and Air Force agreement. UASOO coordinates scheduling, safety and spectrum; obtain current conditions. No transferable BVLOS permission.
properties.access: Coordinated research access; not an open public flying site

properties.name: Virginia Tech Drone Park
properties.published_size: 3 million cubic feet in a 300 ft by 120 ft by 85 ft netted enclosure
properties.launch_recovery: Netted enclosure; the official facility page does not describe a runway
properties.support_infrastructure: Adjacent laboratory, classroom, work, and observation space
properties.aircraft_scope: Drone research, instruction, and controlled flight work
properties.flight_constraints: The enclosure is not considered part of the National Airspace System. Orientation and scheduling are required; commercial and third-party operations have additional requirements.
properties.source_title: Virginia Tech Drone Park facilities and enclosure
properties.secondary_source_title: Virginia Tech Drone Park scheduling and orientation
